text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":5,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"five cell phones"},{"id":"q2","value":150,"unit":"$","kind":"money","span":"$150 each"},{"id":"q3","value":3,"unit":"months","kind":"count","span":"3-month installment"},{"id":"q4","value":2,"unit":"%","kind":"count","span":"2% interest"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q1","q2"],"out":"s1","note":"multiply phones (5) by price each ($150) to find the base total cost"},{"op":"mul","args":["s1","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"multiply the base cost by the percentage number (2) to represent the 2% interest charge on the total"},{"op":"add","args":["s1","s2"],"out":"s3","note":"add the interest amount to the base cost to find the total amount owed"},{"op":"div","args":["s3","q3"],"out":"s4","note":"divide the total amount owed by 3 months to find the monthly payment"}],"target":{"kind":"money","scope":"amount Shiela pays each month over the 3-month installment"},"dismissed":[]}
